_meta.description: Lab reference ranges + clinical interpretation, used by the Day 3 Lab Interpreter agent.

interpretation.low: Leukopenia - reduced infection-fighting capacity, possible bone marrow suppression
interpretation.elevated: Elevated WBC suggests active infection or inflammation
interpretation.critical: Severely abnormal WBC - possible sepsis or hematologic emergency

interpretation.elevated: Elevated CRP indicates systemic inflammation or infection
interpretation.critical: Markedly elevated CRP suggests severe infection or inflammatory process

interpretation.low: Hypoglycemia - can cause dizziness, confusion, palpitations
interpretation.elevated: Hyperglycemia - possible undiagnosed or poorly controlled diabetes
interpretation.critical: Severe glucose derangement requiring urgent attention

interpretation.low: Anemia - reduced oxygen-carrying capacity, explains fatigue/pallor/dizziness
interpretation.elevated: Polycythemia - possible chronic hypoxia or bone marrow disorder

interpretation.critical: Markedly elevated troponin - strongly suggests acute MI

interpretation.elevated: Elevated D-dimer raises suspicion for thromboembolic disease
interpretation.critical: Very high D-dimer strongly suggests pulmonary embolism or DVT

interpretation.elevated: Elevated creatinine suggests impaired kidney function
interpretation.critical: Severely elevated creatinine - possible acute kidney injury

interpretation.elevated: Elevated BUN suggests dehydration or reduced kidney function

interpretation.low: Hyponatremia - can cause confusion, nausea, weakness
Hypokalemia - risk of arrhythmia, muscle weakness
interpretation.elevated: Hyperkalemia - risk of dangerous cardiac arrhythmia
interpretation.critical: Critical potassium level - immediate cardiac risk

interpretation.elevated: Thrombocytosis - possible reactive process or bone marrow disorder

interpretation.critical: Markedly elevated BNP - decompensated heart failure likely
Very high procalcitonin - risk of sepsis

interpretation.elevated: Elevated AST suggests liver or muscle injury
